lansync.title: How LAN Sync Works
lansync.subtitle: Share patient data between workstations on your local network — no cloud, no delays, no GDPR risk.

step1.title: 1. Set Up a Shared Folder
step1.desc: Point PISUM to a shared network folder (NAS, SMB share, or network drive). All workstations on the same network will then access the same database.

step2.title: 2. One Shared Password
step2.desc: The database is AES-256 encrypted. Set a single password on the first workstation — all other computers enter the same password to connect.

step3.title: 3. Instant Sync Across Computers
step3.desc: Each workstation reads from and writes directly to the shared database. Changes appear instantly on all connected computers.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro: Everything you need to know before subscribing.
faq.q1: Can I change my plan at any time?
faq.a1: Yes — you can upgrade or cancel your subscription at any time from your dashboard. Changes take effect immediately.
faq.q2: Is there a minimum commitment period?
faq.a2: No. All plans are monthly, with no commitments. Annual billing saves you 20% compared to monthly payments. You can cancel anytime from your dashboard.
faq.q3: Is the Free plan truly free?
faq.a3: Yes — no credit card required, no time limit. The Free plan allows you to explore PISUM with 10 templates, 50 reports per month, and PDF export. Upgrade when you're ready.
faq.a4: AI Dictation converts your voice into structured radiology report text in real-time. It operates via a secure API — audio is never stored. Your monthly limit renews on the first day of each month.
faq.a5: All payments are processed by Lemon Squeezy, a PCI-compliant payment platform. PISUM never stores your banking details.
faq.q6: Where is my data stored? Is PISUM GDPR compliant?
faq.a6: Your patient reports are stored locally on your computer — PISUM never uploads clinical data to the cloud. Account data (name, email, subscription status) is hosted on Supabase with servers in the EU. PISUM is fully GDPR compliant.
faq.q7: Does PISUM require an internet connection?
faq.a7: Yes. PISUM requires an active internet connection for AI Dictation, AI Enhancer, and subscription management. Your patient reports and templates are stored locally on your computer, but AI features connect securely to our cloud API.
faq.q8: Is there a free trial for paid plans?
faq.a8: The Free plan is a permanent free tier — no time limit, no credit card. Starter, Pro, and Expert include a 14-day free trial, allowing you to experience the full feature set risk-free before being charged. All paid plans are also covered by a 30-day money-back guarantee.
